dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you could just start... looking for some treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Huh? How's that going to work? No compass, no guide, no trusty weapon close at hand... If I set off like this, I'd be doing nothing more than going for a long walk.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Before I leave, I need to be fully prepared! That's why I need to spend more time around experienced old hands, learning everything I can.
